purpose: make mission, repo, work, crew, evidence and historical lineage explicit and recursively traceable
rules: every child must resolve to at least one parent except declared roots
parent-child does not imply authority inheritance
authority inheritance must be explicitly declared and is false by default
commit and PR lineage preserves exact immutable identifiers
historical supersession never deletes prior evidence; it marks currency separately
nested repo/subrepo boundaries receive their own node when manifest workflow runtime or authority is independent
mission child promotion requires observed evidence and the mission launch gate; scout/read relationships alone never promote
cross-mission edges route through MissionControl federation

historian_binding.neuron_handoff: decompose temporal lineage into nodes and edges
historian_binding.keb_handoff: challenge inferred causal edges and authority claims
historian_binding.h4_handoff: use recurrence, reversals and lineage complexity as resource-pressure features
